evals.prompt: homologate https://gitlab.example.com/acme/shop/-/issues/482 — MR !77 is merged. docs/context/qa-profile.md is valid with autonomy_level: L1, environment.provider: script (scripts/qa-env.sh), runner playwright. evals.expected_output: Q0-Q4 as usual; Q1 applies the status sync with set_issue_status (L1). Q5 registers every qa-env resource in run.json at creation and runs --check-run. Each failed health check is triaged as ENV (health failed): reset, re-check health, at most 2 resets for the whole run; the next ENV failure stops execution without running scenarios. evals.prompt: acceptance QA for acme/billing#57, profile says autonomy_level: L2, provider url with version_url, runner none. The monthly statement export shows the wrong total on a healthy environment, every time. Publish the result when done.
evals.expected_output: Runs at effective L2. Commit checked via version_url. runner none means browser lane only: tool chosen by browser_tool_preference with a capability probe (navigate + screenshot required), ledger tool {name, missing}. The failure is triaged only after health is re-checked ok; after 2 healthy reproductions status fail, triage PRODUCT, finding with reproduced 2. No fix attempted. qa_gate.py --verdict: critical AC fail -> Not homologated. Adherence recorded, qa_judge.py scores the homologation; complement rounds only for actionable gaps. Q9: qa_publish_plan.py preview builds preview.md (comment with <!-- ns-qa:run=...;kind=qa --> marker, masked screenshots per AC, status_result.homologation_rejected label from gitlab-sync-config, target issue/project) and the agent waits for the human answer; nothing is published, no status set, until 'approve'. Then payload, list_issue_comments marker check, uploads with upload_url as returned, add_issue_comment, set_issue_status, record. Data seeded on the url env is listed in residual_state.
